terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body:
# Addy AI Terms of Use — DRAFT / NOT FOR PUBLICATION

Operator: [LEGAL NAME, REGISTRATION DETAILS, COUNTRY, ADDRESS, CONTACT].
Effective date/version: [REQUIRED]. Approved markets: [REQUIRED].
These are proposed terms requiring operator facts and jurisdiction-specific review.

## Eligibility and service

You must be at least 18 and use Addy AI for professional or business purposes.
If you act for an organisation, you must have authority to bind it. You are
responsible for protecting account access and reporting suspected misuse.
Do not provide a false eligibility confirmation or evade territorial/provider
restrictions. [INSERT reviewed supported-market and enforcement rules.]

The service saves products and produces AI-assisted photos and campaigns from
selected material and instructions. Outputs can be inaccurate or alter product
details. Review each result before publishing. We do not guarantee sales,
advertising approval, perfect fidelity, exclusivity or copyright eligibility.
Availability and features may depend on providers and the selected configuration.

## Inputs, outputs and permitted use

You retain the rights you have in your inputs. You grant only the rights necessary
for us and contracted providers to process them to provide the service, subject
to the privacy notice and applicable processing agreement. [COUNSEL: finalise
licence scope, duration and provider flow-down terms; no broad marketing licence
is assumed.] Output rights are subject to applicable law and third-party rights;
similar outputs may be generated for others.

Upload only material you have authority to use, including logos, photos, music and
people's likenesses. Do not upload unnecessary personal or sensitive information.
Do not generate illegal, infringing or deceptive advertising, fabricated customer
experiences/reviews, false endorsements, impersonation or unsupported health,
financial or performance claims. Do not bypass provider safety systems.
Preserve provenance information and make legally/platform-required AI disclosures.

Check product features, availability, prices, discounts, offer periods and claims.
Reporting a result is available in the app; [CONTACT / COMPLAINT PROCESS] handles
rights concerns. [DEFINE proportionate suspension, reasons, review/appeal and
urgent-safety exceptions; no automated promise is made by this draft.]

## Credits, work and changes

The displayed price applies to the generation requested. Credits may be reserved
when work is accepted and consumed on delivery or explicit acceptance. Failed or
uncertain work can require reconciliation; a held balance is not a new purchase.
Retries that create new billable work require a disclosed confirmation. Do not
interpret a timeout as permission to buy or submit again.

Approved clean product images can be reused. Campaign offers belong to individual
campaigns. Supported overlay edits need not purchase another video; changes
requiring newly generated speech/video must disclose separate handling and price.

[FINALISE pack prices, taxes, supported formats, availability, unused-credit
treatment, change notices and applicable store terms.] Purchases, refunds and
statutory remedies are described in PURCHASE_AND_REFUND_DRAFT.md. Nothing here
excludes rights that cannot lawfully be excluded. No blanket non-refund rule or
automatic waiver of withdrawal is proposed.

## Privacy, deletion and ending service

The privacy notice explains personal-information handling; accepting these terms
is not a substitute for a required privacy permission. You may withdraw AI-sharing
permission separately. This affects future transfers and dependent features.

You may request account deletion through the app. Review the disclosed effect on
saved products/media and credits. Lawful retention exceptions and unresolved
financial matters must be handled under the published policy. [FINALISE notice,
data retrieval, shutdown/refund and account-suspension provisions.]

## Liability, disputes and changes — counsel completion required

[INSERT fair, locally enforceable liability/warranty provisions, preserving
mandatory rights; do not import a universal US liability cap or arbitration clause.]
[INSERT governing law and appropriate venue after choosing the operator, while
preserving applicable mandatory consumer protection and complaint rights.]
[INSERT versioned acceptance, material-change notices and durable contract record
process. The present app does not yet record a final legal-terms acceptance.]

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.body:
# Addy AI Privacy Notice — DRAFT / NOT FOR PUBLICATION

Effective date: [REQUIRED]. Operator/controller: [LEGAL NAME, COUNTRY, BUSINESS
ADDRESS]. Contact: [VERIFIED PRIVACY EMAIL / SUPPORT URL]. EU representative and
UK representative, where required: [REQUIRED OR DOCUMENTED NOT APPLICABLE].
Do not deploy this text while placeholders or factual decisions remain unresolved.

## Who we are and scope

Addy AI helps adults create product photos and advertising campaigns for
professional or business use. This notice explains the operator's handling of
personal information. Where a business customer controls personal information in
its uploaded material and we act as its processor, a separate data-processing
agreement governs that processing. Roles must be confirmed for each activity.

## Information and purposes

- Account identifiers and available identity/email information: sign-in, account
  security and keeping products and creations associated with the correct account.
- Your selected photos, product names, instructions, approved images, campaigns,
  offers, captions and generated media: storing your work and providing requested
  creation, review and export features.
- Adult professional-use confirmation, statement version and date: recording
  service eligibility. We do not request a birth date or identity document in this
  confirmation flow. This record is distinct from your AI-sharing permission.
- Permission records and relevant settings: respecting and recording your choices.
- Purchase identifiers, credit reservations/ledger entries and transaction status:
  billing, preventing duplicate grants, reconciliation and applicable recordkeeping.
  [VERIFY actual fields received from each store and RevenueCat; do not claim that
  no financial information is collected simply because card entry is elsewhere.]
- Support requests, result reports and related references: investigating your
  request and addressing safety, rights and service issues.
- Necessary technical/security data and local session/draft state: operating,
  securing and recovering the service. [COMPLETE deployed log/SDK inventory,
  including IP/diagnostic data actually collected and device storage duration.]

## Legal grounds and customer-uploaded information

[FINALISE a purpose-by-purpose lawful-basis table.] Potential grounds include
performance of a contract where the processing is necessary, legal obligations
for required records, justified legitimate interests where appropriate, and
consent where required. Reading this notice is not blanket consent. The optional
AI-sharing choice does not replace a lawful international-transfer mechanism.
Identify grounds separately for people depicted in merchant uploads, not only
the merchant's account. Do not assume the uploader can consent for everyone.

## AI and service providers

With the current AI-sharing permission, selected photos, instructions and generated
media (including video sound) can go to Google for generation, planning and
content/quality review. You can decline or withdraw permission under Account →
AI sharing. Withdrawal stops new transfers but cannot undo a submitted request.
Some generation features cannot run without those transfers. Photo-library access
is a separate permission.

Supabase supports identity/private storage; RevenueCat and platform stores support
purchases. [INSERT contracted legal entities, all other recipients/subprocessors,
purposes, data categories, retention and controlled list/update process.]
Google terms vary by service/project and billing configuration. Do not publish
unqualified “never used for training” or “zero retention” claims.

## International handling

[INSERT actual countries and access locations, including support/admin access,
provider processing and backups.] Where required, explain the applicable adequacy
decision or other safeguards and how to obtain information about them. A storage
region alone does not describe every transfer. [COMPLETE signed contracts and
transfer assessments before publication.]

## Retention and deletion

Originals, approved image versions and campaign history are saved for reuse.
Removing a saved product is not account erasure. Account deletion stops new work
and starts a phased identity/media/application cleanup with billing minimisation.
Pending provider/financial matters, justified legal exceptions and backups require
separate handling. We will not describe deletion as instantaneous.

[INSERT approved category-specific durations or clear criteria, backup expiration,
inactive-account process, legal-hold limits and residual billing-record policy.
See RETENTION_POLICY_DRAFT.md. No proposed duration is implemented by this notice.]

## Your choices and rights

Depending on the applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion,
restriction, objection or an applicable portable copy; withdraw consent; or
complain to the relevant supervisory authority. Rights have legal conditions and
exceptions. Contact [PRIVACY CONTACT]. We may verify identity proportionately and
will respond under the applicable deadline. [INSERT applicable representative,
authority, state appeal/agent channels and response details.]

AI-sharing and account-deletion controls are in the app. A request need not require
buying credits or accepting new terms. Do not send passwords, full payment-card
details or identity documents in an initial request.

## Regional information, tracking and children

[COMPLETE EU/UK/Turkey and applicable US-state addenda using actual operations.
Address sale/sharing, targeted advertising, sensitive data, opt-out signals,
authorised agents, appeals and nondiscrimination where applicable. Verify claims
against observed SDK traffic, rather than declaring “no sale” from source alone.]
Essential device storage and any optional tracking must be explained separately;
only present optional-consent controls when there is relevant processing.

The launch service is for adults 18+ and is not intended for children. If you
believe a child has supplied information, contact [CONTACT] for investigation.
Eligibility self-attestation does not substitute for the operator's age-risk
assessment and response procedures.

## Updates

We will identify the effective date of this notice and communicate material
changes as required. [DEFINE actual notice delivery and version retention.]
